> Unified CLI utility for Apple App Store Connect and Google Play operations.
> Version: 0.11.0

<!-- source: guide/getting-started.md -->

# Getting Started

![appitool](https://appitool.appibara.com/banner.png)

`appitool` is a unified Swift CLI utility and release orchestration engine for Apple App Store Connect, Apple Developer Portal, Google Play Console, Firebase App Distribution, Firebase Authentication, and Git-backed code signing.

## Requirements

- **Prebuilt binary (`install.sh` / `self-update`)**:
  - **macOS**: Apple Silicon (`arm64`), macOS 13+
  - **Linux**: `x86_64` (`amd64`) or `arm64` (`aarch64`)
- **Platform build tooling** (only required when compiling mobile apps via `build` or `flow`):
  - **iOS**: macOS with Xcode command-line tools (`xcodebuild`, `xcrun`) and optionally `xcbeautify` (default formatter)
  - **Android**: Java JDK and project `./gradlew` wrapper
- **Building from source**: Swift `6.4+`

---

## Installation

### One-Line Quick Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appibara-ltd/appitool/main/install.sh | bash
```

The installer:
1. Detects your OS and CPU architecture (`darwin-arm64`, `linux-x86_64`, or `linux-arm64`).
2. Downloads the release tarball and `checksums.txt` from `appibara-ltd/appitool`.
3. Verifies the SHA256 checksum.
4. Installs the binary to `/usr/local/bin/appitool` (if writable) or `~/.local/bin/appitool` (automatically updating `~/.zshrc`, `~/.bash_profile`, `~/.bashrc`, or `~/.config/fish/config.fish`).

### Avoiding GitHub API Rate Limits (Optional)

In CI or shared networks, pass a GitHub Personal Access Token via `GITHUB_TOKEN` (or `GH_TOKEN`) to avoid unauthenticated GitHub API rate limits:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appibara-ltd/appitool/main/install.sh | GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) bash
```

### Build from Source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/appibara-ltd/appitool.git
cd appitool

# Build optimized release binary with minimal binary size
swift build -c release
strip .build/release/appitool

# Optional: Link to PATH
ln -sf "$(pwd)/.build/release/appitool" /usr/local/bin/appitool
```

You can also run directly via Swift Package Manager during development:

```bash
swift run appitool -h
```

---

## Upgrading

`appitool` includes a built-in self-updater with SHA256 verification:

```bash
# Check if a newer release is available
appitool self-update --check

# Upgrade in place
appitool self-update

# Force re-installation even if already on the latest version
appitool self-update --force
```

See [`appitool self-update`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/self-update) for details.

---

## Quick Start

### 1. Create a `.env` File

Copy `.env.example` into your project root and configure your credentials:

```bash
cp .env.example .env
```

### 2. Inspect Local Project Identifiers

Discover iOS bundle identifiers (across targets/configurations) and Android `applicationId`, `namespace`, and product flavors in the current repository:

```bash
appitool inspect
```

### 3. Verify Remote Store Connectivity

Validate your credentials and check the latest build numbers on App Store Connect, Google Play Console, or Firebase App Distribution:

```bash
# Check App Store Connect / TestFlight latest build
appitool check ios -d appstore

# Check Google Play Console latest build
appitool check android -d appstore

# Check Firebase App Distribution latest build
appitool check ios -d adhoc
appitool check android -d adhoc
```

### 4. Run a Dry-Run Release Flow

Validate all requirements, project detection, Match sync (in read-only mode), and build-number calculation without modifying project files or uploading binaries:

```bash
appitool flow ios -d appstore --dry-run
appitool flow android -d adhoc --dry-run
```

<!-- source: guide/configuration.md -->

# Configuration & `.env`

`appitool` uses a strict, deterministic configuration model. Commands resolve CLI options with environment variable fallbacks, while internal tasks, services, and flow presets receive resolved values explicitly.

## Resolution Priority

Options and credentials are resolved in the following priority order (highest to lowest):

1. **Explicit CLI Flags** (e.g., `-b com.example.app`, `--apple-key-id ...`)
2. **Process Environment Variables** (already exported in your shell or CI runner)
3. **`.env` File** (automatically loaded from the current working directory if present; existing environment variables are **not** overwritten)

---

## `.env` Parser (`EnvLoader`)

The built-in `EnvLoader` parses `.env` files without external dependencies and supports:

- **Comments**: Full-line `#` comments and trailing inline comments preceded by a space (`KEY=value # comment`).
- **`export ` prefix**: Standard shell syntax like `export APPLE_KEY_ID=2X9R4HXF34`.
- **Single and double quotes**: Single quotes (`'...'`) preserve literal values; double quotes (`"..."`) unescape `\n`, `\r`, `\t`, `\"`, and `\\`.
- **Multiline quoted values**: Multiline PEM keys or JSON payloads enclosed in quotes.
- **`=` preservation**: Base64 padding (`=`) and URL query strings (`?token=...`) are preserved intact.
- **Tilde (`~`) expansion**: Paths starting with `~/` expand to the current user's home directory where path resolution is supported.
- **Empty value handling**: Keys with empty or whitespace-only values (e.g., `MATCH_GIT_BRANCH=`) are skipped during `.env` injection and treated as unset when read via `EnvLoader.value(for:)`, so built-in defaults and fallbacks apply across both `.env` files and CI/shell environments.

---

## Environment Variables Reference

### Identifier Resolution Order

App identifiers are resolved the same way by every command: **CLI option → `.env` variable → local project detection**.

| Identifier | CLI Option | `.env` Variable | Project Detection |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| iOS bundle ID | `-b, --bundle-id` | `APPLE_BUNDLE_ID` | Main target bundle ID from the local Xcode project |
| Android package name | `--package-name` | `GOOGLE_PACKAGE_NAME` | `applicationId` / `namespace` from the local Android project |
| Firebase App ID | `--firebase-app-id` | `FIREBASE_IOS_APP_ID` / `FIREBASE_ANDROID_APP_ID` (by platform) | — |

> `flow ios` and `flow android` skip the generic project detection here because their presets detect identifiers themselves (scheme- and flavor-aware).

### Apple App Store Connect & Developer Portal

| Variable | Description | Example / Default |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `APPLE_KEY_ID` | App Store Connect API Key ID | `2X9R4HXF34` |
| `APPLE_ISSUER_ID` | App Store Connect API Issuer UUID | `57246542-96fe-1a63-e053-0824d011072a` |
| `APPLE_KEY` | Path to `.p8` file, raw PEM string, or Base64-encoded `.p8` | `./AuthKey_2X9R4HXF34.p8` |
| `APPLE_BUNDLE_ID` | Default iOS bundle identifier | `com.example.app` |
| `APPLE_TEAM_ID` | Apple Developer Team ID (10-character alphanumeric) | `ABCDE12345` |

### iOS `xcodebuild` Configuration

| Variable | Description | Default / Behavior |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `XCODE_WORKSPACE` | Path to `.xcworkspace` | Auto-discovered in `.` or `ios/` |
| `XCODE_PROJECT` | Path to `.xcodeproj` | Auto-discovered in `.` or `ios/` |
| `XCODE_SCHEME` | Xcode scheme name to build | Auto-inferred via `xcodebuild -list -json` |
| `XCODE_CONFIGURATION` | Build configuration (`Release` or `Debug`) | `Release` |
| `XCODEBUILD_FORMATTER` | Pipe formatter for `xcodebuild` output | `xcbeautify --renderer github-actions` |

### Google Play Developer API

| Variable | Description | Example / Default |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `GOOGLE_KEY` | Path to Service Account JSON, raw JSON string, or Base64 JSON | `./service-account.json` |
| `GOOGLE_PACKAGE_NAME` | Target Android application package name | `com.example.app` |
| `GOOGLE_PLAY_ACCOUNT_ID` | Play Console account ID for `google` user commands: the number in `play.google.com/console/developers/<id>` (not the Google Cloud project, service account, or package name). `--account-id` overrides it. | `1234567890123456789` |

### Store Assets (`apple assets` & `google assets`)

| Variable | Description | Default / Behavior |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `STORE_ASSETS_PATH` | Folder that `assets` and `metadata` `download` write to and `upload` read from by default. Absolute, `~`-prefixed, or relative to the current directory. Store folders go directly inside it: `<path>/apple/<locale>/<type|metadata>/` and `<path>/google/<locale>/<type|metadata>/` (no project folder, since the path is project-specific). `-o, --output` and explicit upload paths still take precedence. | Unset or empty: `~/.appitool/assets/<project>/<store>/` |
| `APPLE_REVIEW_DEMO_PASSWORD` | App Review demo account password sent by `apple metadata upload` when it differs from the current value. Never written to or read from metadata files; masked in output. | Unset: password is not changed |

### Android Gradle & Keystore Signing

| Variable | Description | Default / Behavior |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `ANDROID_PROJECT_DIR` | Android root directory containing `gradlew` | `./android` if present, else `.` |
| `ANDROID_FLAVOR` | Gradle product flavor (e.g., `production`, `staging`); fallback for `build android --flavor` and `flow android --flavor` | None |
| `ANDROID_CONFIGURATION` | Build type (`Release` or `Debug`) | `Release` |
| `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PATH` | Path to local `.keystore` / `.jks` file | None |
| `ANDROID_KEYSTORE` | Base64-encoded keystore content (decoded to temporary keystore) | None |
| `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD` | Keystore store password | None |
| `ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS` | Key alias inside keystore | None |
| `ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD` | Key password | None |

### Firebase (App Distribution & Auth)

| Variable | Description | Notes |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `FIREBASE_IOS_APP_ID` | Firebase App ID for iOS (`1:<project>:ios:<hash>`) | Used by `check ios`, `flow ios -d adhoc`, and `firebase` commands |
| `FIREBASE_ANDROID_APP_ID` | Firebase App ID for Android (`1:<project>:android:<hash>`) | Used by `check android`, `flow android -d adhoc`, and `firebase` commands |
| `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID` | Firebase / Google Cloud project ID or project number | Falls back to `GOOGLE_PROJECT_ID` or project number parsed from `FIREBASE_*_APP_ID` |
| `GOOGLE_PROJECT_ID` | Fallback Google Cloud project ID when `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID` is unset | Used by `FirebaseProjectOptions` |

### Match Code Signing (`appitool match` & `flow`)

| Variable | Description | Default / Behavior |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `MATCH_GIT_URL` | Git repository URL for certificates/profiles/keystores | Required for Match |
| `MATCH_GIT_BRANCH` | Git branch name | `master` |
| `MATCH_GIT_TOKEN` | HTTPS Git Personal Access Token or SSH private/deploy key (file path, raw PEM, or Base64) | Falls back to `GITHUB_TOKEN`, then `GH_TOKEN` |
| `MATCH_PASSWORD` | Passphrase for AES-256 encryption/decryption | Required for Match |
| `MATCH_KEYCHAIN_NAME` | Custom macOS keychain name or path | `appitool` |
| `MATCH_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD` | Password used to create/unlock custom keychain | `appipass` |
| `MATCH_READONLY` | In `flow ios` (`MatchOptions`), read-only unless set to `"false"` | `true` (unless `"false"`) |
| `MATCH_TYPE` | Default Match profile type for `match ios sync`, `nuke`, and `prune` when `-t, --type` is omitted | `appstore` |

### Webhook Notifications

| Variable | Description | Notes |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `SLACK_URL` | Slack incoming webhook URL | Used by `flow` for success/failure attachments |
| `KOKONO_URL` | KokoNo webhook URL (`https://kokono.me/notify?token=<token>`) | Used by `kokono` and `flow` |
| `KOKONO_E2E_PUBLIC_KEY` | Base64 X25519 recipient public key for KokoNo E2E encryption | Optional |

### GitHub Self-Update

| Variable | Description | Notes |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `GITHUB_TOKEN` | Optional GitHub PAT to avoid API rate limits in `self-update` & Match HTTPS PAT fallback | Falls back to `GH_TOKEN` |
| `GH_TOKEN` | Secondary fallback token in `self-update` & Match | Checked if `GITHUB_TOKEN` is unset |

### CI Mode & Destructive Command Guard

`appitool` resolves CI mode in precedence order: explicit CLI flag (`--ci` / `--no-ci`) → `CI` → CI provider variables. When CI mode is active, destructive commands (`apple delete-*`, `apple prune-*`, `apple devices disable`, `apple invitations cancel`, `apple versions delete`, `apple assets delete`, `google assets delete`, `google users delete`, `google invitations cancel`, `google users revoke`, `firebase apps delete`, `firebase users delete`, `firebase firestore delete`, `match ios nuke`, `match ios prune`) are skipped as a no-op with a warning and exit code `0`.

| Variable | Description | Notes |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `CI` | Generic CI indicator | Any non-empty value except `0`, `false`, `no`, `off` enables CI mode; explicit falsy `CI` suppresses provider fallback |
| `GITHUB_ACTIONS`, `GITLAB_CI`, `BITRISE_IO`, `CIRCLECI`, `BUILDKITE`, `JENKINS_URL`, `TF_BUILD`, `TEAMCITY_VERSION`, `TRAVIS`, `CODEMAGIC_BUILD_ID`, `CI_XCODE_CLOUD` | Provider-specific CI indicators (checked when `CI` is unset or blank) | Evaluated with the same truthy/falsy rules (`0`, `false`, `no`, `off`, and empty strings are ignored) |

---

## Local Storage Architecture (`~/.appitool`)

`appitool` centralizes build artifacts, Xcode DerivedData, temporary keystores, and exported certificates under `~/.appitool` (`AppitoolPaths`):

```text
~/.appitool/
├── ios/
│   └── <TargetName>/
│       ├── build/
│       │   └── <version>_<build>[_adhoc|_development]/  # Falls back to <yyyy_MM_dd_HH_mm>
│       │       ├── <Scheme>.xcarchive
│       │       ├── <Scheme>.ipa
│       │       └── <Scheme>.app.dSYM.zip
│       └── derivedData/
├── android/
│   ├── <TargetName>/
│   │   └── build/
│   │       └── <version>_<build>[_adhoc|_development]/  # Falls back to <yyyy_MM_dd_HH_mm>
│   │           ├── <Target>_release.aab
│   │           └── <Target>_release.apk
│   ├── keystores/
│   │   └── <packageName>.keystore
│   └── tmp/
├── certs/
│   └── <type>/
├── assets/                     # default store assets root; STORE_ASSETS_PATH replaces assets/<project>/ (older versions used ~/.appitool/screenshots/)
│   └── <project>/
│       ├── apple/<locale>/<type>/    # apple assets download / upload: screenshot types (01_<name>.png) and header|search (one image), .appitool-manifest.json for upload --sync
│       ├── apple/<locale>/metadata/  # apple metadata download / upload: <field>.txt (name, subtitle, description, keywords, …)
│       ├── apple/metadata/           # app-level: copyright, categories, App Review details, content rights, accessibility URL
│       ├── google/<locale>/<type>/   # Used by both download and default bulk upload (01.png, .appitool-manifest.json for upload --sync)
│       ├── google/<locale>/metadata/ # google metadata download / upload: title, short_description, full_description, video
│       └── google/metadata/          # app-level: contact_email, contact_phone, contact_website, default_language
└── match/
    └── <UUID>/                  # Temporary Git clone working directory (auto-cleaned)
```

Use [`appitool clean`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/clean) to inspect sizes and prune old build artifacts and iOS `derivedData` directories safely (`certs/` is always preserved; `~/.appitool/assets` and the legacy `~/.appitool/screenshots` are only cleaned with `--assets`).

---

<!-- source: guide/flow-architecture.md -->

# Flow Architecture

`appitool flow` is an opinionated release orchestration engine inspired by Fastlane lanes. Every flow execution transitions sequentially through a standardized 7-stage lifecycle backed by a shared `FlowContext` and a strict error boundary in `FlowRunner`.

## The 7-Stage Pipeline

```text
┌─────────┐   ┌──────────┐   ┌─────────┐   ┌───────────┐   ┌────────────┐   ┌───────────┐   ┌─────────────┐
│  setup  │──▶│ prebuild │──▶│  build  │──▶│ postbuild │──▶│ prerelease │──▶│  release  │──▶│ postrelease │
└─────────┘   └──────────┘   └─────────┘   └───────────┘   └────────────┘   └───────────┘   └─────────────┘
```

| # | Stage (`FlowStage`) | Emoji | Display Name | Core Responsibilities |
|:---:|:---|:---:|:---|:---|
| 1 | `setup` | 🔍 | Setup & Environment | Inspect project (`Xcode` / `Gradle`), resolve bundle ID / package name, sync Match certs/profiles or keystore, fetch latest remote build number. |
| 2 | `prebuild` | 🔧 | Pre-Build & Versioning | Compute next build number / `versionCode` (`max(remote, local) + 1` via `BuildNumberPolicy`), snapshot `project.pbxproj`, apply temporary manual code signing to Xcode targets, and normalize literal `Info.plist` `CFBundleVersion` entries to `$(CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION)` via `XCodeTasks.updateBuildNumber`. |
| 3 | `build` | 🔨 | Build Compilation | Run `xcodebuild` (injecting `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION=<buildNumber>` for `.xcarchive`, `.ipa`, and dSYM, then restoring `project.pbxproj` and any temporary `Info.plist` edits in `defer`) or `./gradlew` (`bundleRelease` / `assembleRelease`) and record artifact paths in `FlowContext`. |
| 4 | `postbuild` | 📦 | Post-Build | Verify that the generated `.ipa`, `.aab`, or `.apk` artifact exists on disk, is non-empty, and log its file size. |
| 5 | `prerelease` | 📝 | Pre-Release | Generate plain-text store release notes via `GenerateReleaseNotesTask` using platform tag prefix (`🍏_` for iOS, `🤖_` for Android) and store character limits (left empty if `HEAD` already sits on a matching tag); supports `--release-notes`, `--notes-from`, and `--notes-locale` overrides and logs the resolved source and preview. |
| 6 | `release` | 🚀 | Release & Store Upload | Upload binary to App Store Connect / TestFlight, Google Play Console `internal` track, or Firebase App Distribution. |
| 7 | `postrelease` | 📣 | Post-Release & Notifications | Create & push the release Git tag (`🍏_<version>_<buildNumber>[_adhoc]` / `🤖_<version>_<buildNumber>[_adhoc]`) via `GitTagTask` and dispatch completion notifications to configured Slack and KokoNo webhooks (previewed / skipped in `--dry-run` mode). |

---

## Built-in Flow Presets

Choosing a platform (`ios` / `android`) and distribution (`appstore`, `adhoc`, `development`) automatically selects a `FlowPreset`:

| Command Invocation | Preset | Target Destination |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `flow ios -d appstore` | `IOSInternalPreset` (`iOS Internal`) | App Store Connect / TestFlight |
| `flow ios -d adhoc` | `IOSAdHocPreset` (`iOS AdHoc`) | Firebase App Distribution (`internal` group) |
| `flow ios -d development` | `IOSDevelopmentPreset` (`iOS Development`) | Firebase App Distribution (`internal` group) |
| `flow android -d appstore` | `AndroidInternalPreset` (`Android Internal`) | Google Play Console (`internal` track) |
| `flow android -d adhoc` | `AndroidAdHocPreset` (`Android AdHoc`) | Firebase App Distribution (`internal` group) |
| `flow android -d development` | `AndroidDevelopmentPreset` (`Android Development`) | Firebase App Distribution (`internal` group) |

> Presets share stage implementations and only supply what differs per destination. Sources are grouped by platform under `Sources/appitool/Flow/Presets/`:
> `iOS/IOSPresetHelpers.swift` (project detection, Match sync, manual signing + build-number bump, archive/export),
> `Android/AndroidPresetHelpers.swift` (project/flavor detection, Gradle build), and
> `Shared/FirebasePresetHelpers.swift` (latest Firebase build lookup and upload/distribution, used by the ad-hoc and development presets).

### 1. `IOSInternalPreset` (`flow ios -d appstore`)

- **Required Configuration (`requirements`)**:
  - `APPLE_KEY_ID`
  - `APPLE_ISSUER_ID`
  - `APPLE_KEY`
  - `MATCH_GIT_URL`
  - `MATCH_PASSWORD`
- **Stage Execution**:
  - `setup`: Detects `.xcworkspace`/`.xcodeproj`, scheme, configuration, main target, bundle ID, and project version. Runs `MatchTask` with `type: .appstore` (forced `readonly` when `--dry-run` is set). Queries App Store Connect (`GetLatestBuildNumberTask`) for the latest TestFlight build number.
  - `prebuild`: Extracts signing identity (`iPhone Distribution` or `Apple Distribution`) and Team ID from installed certificates. Snapshots `project.pbxproj`, configures manual code signing per target via `XCodeTasks.configureManualSigning`, computes `max(appstore_build_number, project build number) + 1` in `context.buildNumber`, and calls `XCodeTasks.updateBuildNumber` to normalize literal `Info.plist` `CFBundleVersion` values to `$(CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION)` without editing `project.pbxproj` (permanently when `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION` is already defined in `project.pbxproj`, or registered for post-build restore otherwise; skipped in `--dry-run`).
  - `build`: Prepares macOS keychain (`KeychainManager`), compiles `.xcarchive` (passing `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION=<buildNumber>`) and exports `.ipa` with `.appStore` export method and manual signing via `XcodeBuildTask`, restoring `project.pbxproj` and any temporary `Info.plist` edits immediately in `defer` (skipped in `--dry-run`).
  - `postbuild`: Verifies `.ipa` existence and non-zero file size (skipped in `--dry-run`).
  - `prerelease`: Generates plain-text release notes (max 4,000 chars) from commits since the latest `🍏_*` tag (excluding `*_adhoc` / `*_development`) via `GenerateReleaseNotesTask`.
  - `release`: Uploads `.ipa` via `UploadToAppStoreTask`, waits for App Store Connect build processing (unless `--no-wait-processing` is passed), and sets TestFlight "What to Test" notes via `setWhatsNew` when `changelog` is populated.
  - `postrelease`: Creates and pushes Git tag `🍏_<version>_<buildNumber>` via `GitTagTask` and dispatches Slack/KokoNo notifications (skipped in `--dry-run`).

### 2. `IOSAdHocPreset` (`flow ios -d adhoc`)

- **Required Configuration (`requirements`)**:
  - `MATCH_GIT_URL`
  - `MATCH_PASSWORD`
  - `FIREBASE_IOS_APP_ID`
  - `GOOGLE_KEY`
- **Stage Execution**:
  - `setup`: Inspects iOS project, runs `MatchTask` with `type: .adhoc`, and queries Firebase App Distribution for the latest build number via `FirebasePresetHelpers.fetchLatestBuild` (an app with no releases yet resolves to build `0`; lookup failures stop the flow).
  - `prebuild`: Snapshots `project.pbxproj`, configures manual signing on Xcode targets, computes `max(firebase_build_number, project build number) + 1` in `context.buildNumber`, and normalizes literal `Info.plist` `CFBundleVersion` values to `$(CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION)` via `XCodeTasks.updateBuildNumber` (kept permanently when `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION` exists in `project.pbxproj`, or registered for post-build restore otherwise; skipped in `--dry-run`).
  - `build`: Prepares keychain, builds `.xcarchive` (passing `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION=<buildNumber>`) and exports `.ipa` with `.adHoc` export method, restoring `project.pbxproj` and temporary `Info.plist` edits immediately in `defer` (skipped in `--dry-run`).
  - `postbuild`: Verifies `.ipa` existence and non-zero file size (skipped in `--dry-run`).
  - `prerelease`: Generates plain-text release notes (max 4,000 chars) from commits since the latest `🍏_*` tag via `GenerateReleaseNotesTask`.
  - `release`: Uploads the `.ipa` with generated release notes via the shared `FirebasePresetHelpers.distribute`, which runs `UploadToFirebaseTask` with `ensureGroupsExist` so the `internal` tester group is created on Firebase (`createOrGetGroup`) before upload.
  - `postrelease`: Creates and pushes Git tag `🍏_<version>_<buildNumber>_adhoc` via `GitTagTask` and dispatches success notification to configured Slack and KokoNo webhooks (skipped in `--dry-run`).

### 2b. `IOSDevelopmentPreset` (`flow ios -d development`)

Same stages and requirements as `IOSAdHocPreset`, with development signing:

- `setup`: Runs `MatchTask` with `type: .development` (development certificates and profiles).
- `prebuild`: Uses a development signing identity (`Apple Development` / `iPhone Developer`, falling back to `Apple Development`).
- `build`: Exports the `.ipa` with the `.development` export method.
- `release`: Uploads via `FirebasePresetHelpers.distribute`. Development-signed builds install only on devices included in the development provisioning profile.
- `postrelease`: Tags `🍏_<version>_<buildNumber>_development`.

### 3. `AndroidInternalPreset` (`flow android -d appstore`)

- **Required Configuration (`requirements`)**:
  - `GOOGLE_KEY`
- **Stage Execution**:
  - `setup`: Extracts `packageName`, `applicationId`, `namespace`, `versionName`, `versionCode`, and flavors via regex (`AndroidTasks.getAndroidIdentifiers`) and Gradle evaluation (`evaluateAppInfoViaGradle`). When `--flavor` / `ANDROID_FLAVOR` is set, the selected flavor's effective `applicationId` (unless `--package-name` is given), `versionName`, and `versionCode` are used, and a warning is logged if the flavor is not found. If `MATCH_GIT_URL` and `MATCH_PASSWORD` are configured, resolves the release keystore via `AndroidPresetHelpers.resolveMatchKeystore` (the flow fails if the package name is unknown or the Match lookup fails, instead of building unsigned). Queries Google Play Console (`internal` track) for the latest `versionCode`.
  - `prebuild`: Sets `versionCode` to `max(googleplay_version_code, project versionCode) + 1` in `context.buildNumber`.
  - `build`: Executes Gradle `bundleRelease` (or `bundle<Flavor>Release` with `--flavor`) producing an `.aab` with `-PversionCode` and `-PversionName` plus Match signing config if present.
  - `postbuild`: Verifies `.aab` existence and logs file size.
  - `prerelease`: Generates plain-text release notes (max 500 chars for Google Play) from commits since the latest `🤖_*` tag (excluding `*_adhoc` / `*_development`) via `GenerateReleaseNotesTask`.
  - `release`: Uploads `.aab` and generated release notes to Google Play Console `internal` track with `releaseStatus: .completed` via `UploadToGooglePlayConsoleTask`.
  - `postrelease`: Creates and pushes Git tag `🤖_<version>_<buildNumber>` via `GitTagTask` and dispatches success notification to Slack and KokoNo webhooks (skipped in `--dry-run`).

### 4. `AndroidAdHocPreset` (`flow android -d adhoc`)

- **Required Configuration (`requirements`)**:
  - `FIREBASE_ANDROID_APP_ID`
  - `GOOGLE_KEY`
- **Stage Execution**:
  - `setup`: Inspects Android project, resolves the release keystore from Match when configured (failing the flow if the lookup fails), and retrieves the latest Firebase App Distribution build via `FirebasePresetHelpers.fetchLatestBuild` (an app with no releases yet resolves to build `0`; lookup failures stop the flow).
  - `prebuild`: Sets `versionCode` to `max(firebase_build_number, project versionCode) + 1`.
  - `build`: Runs Gradle `assembleRelease` (default `.apk`) or `bundleRelease` (if `--format aab` is specified); with `--flavor`, runs `assemble<Flavor>Release` / `bundle<Flavor>Release`.
  - `postbuild`: Verifies artifact file integrity and logs size.
  - `prerelease`: Generates plain-text release notes (max 4,000 chars) from commits since the latest `🤖_*` tag via `GenerateReleaseNotesTask`.
  - `release`: Uploads the `.apk`/`.aab` with generated release notes via the shared `FirebasePresetHelpers.distribute` (same as iOS Ad-Hoc), which runs `UploadToFirebaseTask` with `ensureGroupsExist` so the `internal` tester group is created before upload.
  - `postrelease`: Creates and pushes Git tag `🤖_<version>_<buildNumber>_adhoc` via `GitTagTask` and dispatches success notification to Slack and KokoNo webhooks (skipped in `--dry-run`).

### 5. `AndroidDevelopmentPreset` (`flow android -d development`)

Same stages and requirements as `AndroidAdHocPreset`, with a debug build:

- `setup`: Does not resolve a Match keystore; the project's Gradle debug signing config signs the build.
- `build`: Runs Gradle `assembleDebug` (default `.apk`) or `bundleDebug` (with `--format aab`); with `--flavor`, runs `assemble<Flavor>Debug` / `bundle<Flavor>Debug`. Artifact name: `<Target>_[<flavor>_]debug`.
- `release`: Uploads via `FirebasePresetHelpers.distribute`.
- `postrelease`: Tags `🤖_<version>_<buildNumber>_development`.

---

## Global Error Boundary & Cleanup

`FlowRunner` wraps all stage execution inside a unified error boundary:

- **Pre-flight Validation**: `preset.requirements(context:)` runs before any stage executes, throwing `FlowRequirementError` with the full list of missing configuration keys.
- **Temporary File & Keystore Cleanup**: `TemporaryFileRestorer` (owned by `FlowContext.fileRestorer`) snapshots `project.pbxproj` before signing mutations and any temporary `Info.plist` edits made when `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION` is missing in `project.pbxproj`; iOS `build` restores them in `defer` and `FlowRunner`'s `defer` block (plus `SIGINT`/`SIGTERM` signal handlers) acts as an emergency fallback if a stage exits early. For Android, any temporary keystore decrypted by Match (`context.androidSigningTempUrl`) and empty `~/.appitool/android/keystores` directories are deleted automatically.
- **Failure Handling**: If any stage throws:
  1. Pipeline execution halts immediately.
  2. `FlowRunner` prints a highlighted banner showing the failing stage (`context.currentStage`) and error reason.
  3. `NotifyTask().notifyAllConfigured(status: .failure, ...)` dispatches failure alerts to Slack and KokoNo containing `Platform`, `Distribution`, `Failing Stage`, `Elapsed Time`, and `Bundle ID` / `Package Name` (skipped when `--dry-run` is active).
- **Success Summary**: Upon completing all configured stages, `FlowRunner` prints total elapsed time and per-stage durations.

---

<!-- source: guide/code-signing-match.md -->

# Code Signing & Match

`appitool match` implements Git-backed encrypted storage for Apple signing assets and Android keystores, providing binary and encryption parity with **Fastlane Match**.

## How Match Works

1. **Clone Git Storage (`GitStorage`)**: Clones the target Git repository branch (shallow clone when in `readonly` / `sync` mode) into a temporary directory under `~/.appitool/match/<UUID>` and cleans it up in `defer`. Authenticates HTTPS URLs via token injection and SSH URLs (`git@...` / `ssh://...`) via `GIT_SSH_COMMAND` using a temporary `0600` key file resolved from `MATCH_GIT_TOKEN` (file path, raw PEM, or Base64), cleaned up on exit. If the requested branch does not yet exist on the remote, `appitool` creates an isolated orphan branch (matching Fastlane Match behavior).
2. **Decrypt Assets (`MatchEncryption`)**: Decrypts certificates, provisioning profiles, and Android keystores in-place using `MATCH_PASSWORD`.
3. **Sync / Prune / Nuke / Add**:
   - **iOS**: Validates certificates and profiles against Apple Developer Portal (when App Store Connect API credentials are supplied), creates missing/expired assets when writable, imports `.p12` certificates into a dedicated macOS Keychain, and installs `.mobileprovision` / `.provisionprofile` files for Xcode.
   - **Android**: Resolves `<packageName>.keystore` (or `.jks` / `.p12`) and `<packageName>.json` credential metadata, or encrypts and pushes a new keystore when adding.
4. **Re-encrypt & Push**: Encrypts modified assets using Match V2 (`AES-256-GCM`), commits with `-c commit.gpgsign=false` so global signing configs never prompt interactively, and pushes changes back to the remote Git repository.

---

## Encryption Compatibility (V1 & V2)

`MatchEncryption` supports both Fastlane Match encryption formats:

| Format | Header Prefix | Algorithm | Key Derivation | Behavior |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **V2 (Default for writes)** | `match_encrypted_v2__` | `AES-256-GCM` (Base64-encoded, 64-char lines) | PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (10,000 iterations, 8-byte random salt, 24-byte AAD) | Used for all newly encrypted files |
| **V1 (Legacy read support)** | `Salted__` | `AES-256-CBC` (Base64-encoded) | OpenSSL `EVP_BytesToKey` (MD5, SHA-256) or PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 fallback | Supported seamlessly during decryption |

---

## Git Repository Structure

```text
<match-git-repo>/
├── certs/
│   ├── development/
│   │   ├── <CERT_ID>.cer
│   │   └── <CERT_ID>.p12
│   ├── distribution/          # Used by both 'appstore' and 'adhoc'
│   │   ├── <CERT_ID>.cer
│   │   └── <CERT_ID>.p12
│   ├── enterprise/
│   └── developer_id/
├── profiles/
│   ├── development/
│   │   └── Development_<bundleId>[_tvos|_catalyst].mobileprovision
│   ├── adhoc/
│   │   └── AdHoc_<bundleId>[_tvos|_catalyst].mobileprovision
│   ├── appstore/
│   │   └── AppStore_<bundleId>[_tvos|_catalyst].mobileprovision
│   ├── enterprise/
│   │   └── InHouse_<bundleId>.mobileprovision
│   └── developer_id/
│       └── DeveloperID_<bundleId>.provisionprofile
└── android/
    ├── release/
    │   ├── <packageName>.keystore
    │   └── <packageName>.json
    └── debug/
        ├── <packageName>.keystore
        └── <packageName>.json
```

### Wildcard Profile Matching (iOS)

When searching for a profile matching `<bundleId>`, `MatchRunner` looks for:
1. Exact match (`<Prefix>_<bundleId><suffix>.<ext>`)
2. Partial wildcard matches (`com.example.*`, selecting the longest/most specific prefix)
3. Global wildcard match (`*`)

---

## macOS Keychain & Xcode Installation

- **Keychain Isolation (`KeychainManager`)**:
  - Defaults to `appitool` (`~/Library/Keychains/appitool.keychain-db`) with password `appipass`, customizable via `MATCH_KEYCHAIN_NAME` and `MATCH_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD` (or `--keychain-name` / `--keychain-password`).
  - Automatically creates the keychain if missing, unlocks it, clears auto-lock timeouts (`set-keychain-settings`), and adds it to the user's keychain search list.
- **Provisioning Profile Path (`ProfileInstaller`)**:
  - Installs profiles into `~/Library/Developer/Xcode/UserData/Provisioning Profiles/<UUID>.mobileprovision` (or `.provisionprofile` for macOS/Catalyst).
- **Fastlane-Compatible Metadata**:
  - Generates `MatchResult.envVariables` entries (`sigh_<bundleId>_<type>`, `_uuid`, `_profile-path`, `_profile-name`, `_team-id`).

---

## Read-Only Mode Semantics

Notice the difference between standalone `appitool match ios sync` and `appitool flow`:

- **`appitool match ios sync`**: `--readonly` defaults to `false` (can create certificates/profiles on Apple Developer Portal if credentials are provided). Pass `--readonly` for CI read-only sync.
- **`appitool flow ios`**: `MatchOptions` defaults `readonly` to `true` unless `MATCH_READONLY=false` is explicitly set in the environment (and `--dry-run` always forces `readonly: true`).

---

<!-- source: commands/overview.md -->

# Command Overview

`appitool` is built with Swift ArgumentParser. Run `appitool --help` (or `-h`) or `appitool <command> --help` at any level to inspect live options, or `appitool --version` to print the installed version.

## Command Structure

Store commands follow `appitool <store> <resource> <action>`: a plural resource noun, then a single verb, e.g. `appitool apple users list`, `appitool google invitations cancel`, `appitool firebase apps create`. Common verbs are `list`, `create`, `update`, and `delete`; some resources add their own (`prune`, `disable`, `invite`, `cancel`, `grant`, `revoke`, `sync`, `export`). Run `appitool <store> <resource> --help` to see a resource's actions.

## Complete Command Tree

| Command | Subcommands / resources | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| [`flow`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/flow) | `ios`, `android` | Runs the automated 7-stage release orchestration pipeline. |
| [`build`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/build) | `ios`, `android` | Compiles and packages iOS (`.xcarchive`/`.ipa`) and Android (`.aab`/`.apk`) artifacts directly. |
| [`check`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/check) | `ios`, `android` | Queries remote store/distribution metadata and latest build numbers. |
| [`match`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/match) | `ios` *(default)*, `android` | Syncs, prunes, nukes, or adds Git-encrypted certificates, profiles, and keystores. |
| [`apple`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/apple) | `apps`, `versions`, `identifiers`, `capabilities`, `profiles`, `certificates`, `devices`, `users`, `invitations`, `assets`, `metadata` | Manages App Store Connect & Developer Portal apps and versions, identifiers, capabilities, profiles, certificates, devices, team users, invitations, store assets (screenshots, product page header, search results), and listing metadata. |
| [`google`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/google) | `apps`, `signing-certs`, `users`, `invitations`, `assets`, `metadata` | Lists accessible apps and signing certificate fingerprints, and manages Google Play Console store visuals and screenshots (`list`, `upload`, `download`, `delete`, `types`), store listing text (`list`, `download`, `upload`), and Play Console users, invitations, and per-app access. |
| [`firebase`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/firebase) | `apps`, `fingerprints`, `releases`, `groups`, `users`, `firestore` | Manages Firebase apps, App Distribution releases/groups, Firebase Auth users, and Cloud Firestore collections/documents. |
| [`inspect`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/inspect) | — | Inspects local iOS and Android identifiers, versions, build numbers, and flavors (supports `--json`). |
| [`clean`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/clean) | — | Cleans cached build outputs, Xcode DerivedData, and (with `--assets`) downloaded store assets under `~/.appitool`. |
| [`notes`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/notes) | — | Generates categorized Markdown release notes from Git conventional commits. |
| [`kokono`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/kokono) | — | Sends push notifications to KokoNo webhooks (plain or E2E encrypted). |
| [`self-update`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/self-update) | — | Checks GitHub Releases and updates the `appitool` binary with SHA256 verification. |
| [`status`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/status) | — | Displays the tool name, purpose, and active version. |

---

## Distribution Modes (`BuildCommand.Distribution`)

Commands that accept `-d, --distribution` (`flow`, `build`, `check`) accept the following distribution values (case-insensitive):

| Value | Accepted Aliases | Typical Target |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `appstore` | `appstore`, `app-store` | Apple App Store / TestFlight or Google Play Console |
| `adhoc` | `adhoc`, `ad-hoc` | Firebase App Distribution (Ad-Hoc IPA / APK) |
| `development` | `development`, `dev` | Local development builds |

---

## Shared Option Groups

Several commands reuse standardized `OptionGroup` structs defined in `CredentialsOptions.swift`. Every option falls back to `.env` / environment variables when omitted.

### `AppleCredentialsOptions`

Used by `flow ios`, `build ios`, `check ios`, `match ios`, and all `apple` commands.

| Flag | `.env` Fallback | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `--apple-key-id <id>` | `APPLE_KEY_ID` | App Store Connect API Key ID |
| `--apple-issuer-id <uuid>` | `APPLE_ISSUER_ID` | App Store Connect API Issuer ID |
| `--apple-key <key>` | `APPLE_KEY` | `.p8` file path, raw PEM content, or Base64 string |

### `GoogleCredentialsOptions`

Used by `flow ios`, `flow android`, `check ios`, `check android`, `GooglePlayAppOptions`, and `FirebaseProjectOptions`.

| Flag | `.env` Fallback | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `-g, --google-key <key>` | `GOOGLE_KEY` | Service Account JSON path, raw JSON string, or Base64 string |

### `GooglePlayAppOptions`

Includes `GoogleCredentialsOptions` and resolves the Android application package name. Used by `google assets <list|upload|download|delete>`.

| Flag | `.env` Fallback | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `-g, --google-key <key>` | `GOOGLE_KEY` | Inherited from `GoogleCredentialsOptions` |
| `--package-name <name>` | `GOOGLE_PACKAGE_NAME` or local Android project | Target Android application package name |

### `FirebaseProjectOptions`

Used by `firebase apps <list|create|delete>`, `fingerprints sync`, `groups <list|create>`, `users <list|delete|export>`, and `firestore <collections|list|get|set|delete|query>` (note: `firestore` falls back to the `project_id` in `GOOGLE_KEY` rather than parsing `FIREBASE_*_APP_ID`).

| Flag | `.env` Fallback | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `-g, --google-key <key>` | `GOOGLE_KEY` | Inherited from `GoogleCredentialsOptions` |
| `--project <id>` | `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID`, `GOOGLE_PROJECT_ID`, or parsed from `FIREBASE_*_APP_ID` | Firebase / Google Cloud project ID or project number |

### `FirebaseCredentialsOptions`

Includes `FirebaseProjectOptions` and adds app-level flags. Used by `firebase releases <list|create|update>`.

| Flag | `.env` Fallback | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `--firebase-app-id <id>` | `FIREBASE_IOS_APP_ID` / `FIREBASE_ANDROID_APP_ID` | Target Firebase App ID |
| `-p, --platform <platform>` | — | Target platform for App ID resolution (`ios` or `android`) |
| `-g, --google-key <key>` | `GOOGLE_KEY` | Inherited from `FirebaseProjectOptions` |
| `--project <id>` | `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID` | Inherited from `FirebaseProjectOptions` |

### `MatchStorageOptions`

Used by `match android`, `flow android`, and `build android` (and embedded in `MatchOptions`).

| Flag | `.env` Fallback / Default | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `--match-git-url <url>` | `MATCH_GIT_URL` | Match Git repository URL |
| `--match-git-branch <branch>` | `MATCH_GIT_BRANCH` (default: `master`) | Git branch name |
| `--match-git-token <token>` | `MATCH_GIT_TOKEN`, `GITHUB_TOKEN`, `GH_TOKEN` | Git HTTPS PAT or SSH private/deploy key (file path, PEM, or Base64) |
| `--match-password <pass>` | `MATCH_PASSWORD` | AES decryption/encryption passphrase |

### `MatchOptions`

Includes `MatchStorageOptions` and adds Apple/iOS signing options. Used by `match ios sync` and `flow ios` (`match ios nuke` and `match ios prune` use only `MatchStorageOptions`).

| Flag | `.env` Fallback / Default | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `--match-git-url <url>` | `MATCH_GIT_URL` | Inherited from `MatchStorageOptions` |
| `--match-git-branch <branch>` | `MATCH_GIT_BRANCH` (default: `master`) | Inherited from `MatchStorageOptions` |
| `--match-git-token <token>` | `MATCH_GIT_TOKEN`, `GITHUB_TOKEN`, `GH_TOKEN` | Inherited from `MatchStorageOptions` |
| `--match-password <pass>` | `MATCH_PASSWORD` | Inherited from `MatchStorageOptions` |
| `--keychain-name <name>` | `MATCH_KEYCHAIN_NAME` (default: `appitool`) | Custom macOS keychain name or path |
| `--keychain-password <pass>` | `MATCH_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD` (default: `appipass`) | Keychain unlock password |
| `--team-id <id>` | `APPLE_TEAM_ID` | Apple Developer Team ID |
| `--readonly` | `MATCH_READONLY != "false"` in `flow ios` (defaults to `true`); `false` in `match ios sync` | Read-only mode (do not create new certs/profiles) |

### `NotificationOptions`

Used by `flow ios` and `flow android`.

| Flag | `.env` Fallback | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `--slack-url <url>` | `SLACK_URL` | Slack incoming webhook URL |
| `--kokono-url <url>` | `KOKONO_URL` | KokoNo notification webhook URL |
| `--kokono-public-key <key>` | `KOKONO_E2E_PUBLIC_KEY` (ignored if `--kokono-url` flag is explicitly passed) | KokoNo E2E encryption public key |

### `GlobalCIOptions`

Available globally on `appitool` (can be placed before or after subcommands, as well as directly on guarded destructive subcommands and `match ios sync`). Auto-detects CI environment variables (`CI`, `GITHUB_ACTIONS`, `GITLAB_CI`, `BITRISE_IO`, `CIRCLECI`, `BUILDKITE`, `JENKINS_URL`, `TF_BUILD`, `TEAMCITY_VERSION`, `TRAVIS`, `CODEMAGIC_BUILD_ID`, `CI_XCODE_CLOUD`) when omitted. In CI mode, destructive commands (`apple identifiers delete`, `apple profiles delete`, `apple profiles prune`, `apple certificates delete`, `apple certificates prune`, `apple devices disable`, `apple users delete`, `apple invitations cancel`, `apple versions delete`, `apple assets delete`, `google assets delete`, `google users delete`, `google invitations cancel`, `google users revoke`, `firebase apps delete`, `firebase users delete`, `firebase firestore delete`, `match ios nuke`, and `match ios prune`) are skipped as a no-op with a warning (exit code `0`).

| Flag | Default / Env Fallback | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `--ci` / `--no-ci` | `CI` and provider env vars (`false` if unset) | Explicitly enable or disable CI mode, overriding environment detection |

### `ReleaseNotesOptions`

Used by `flow ios` and `flow android`.

| Flag | Default | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `--release-notes <text>` | — | Custom release notes text (bypasses Git commit generation) |
| `--notes-from <ref>` | — | Starting Git tag or commit reference for release notes generation (overrides auto-tag detection) |
| `--notes-locale <locale>` | `en-US` | Locale/language code for store release notes (e.g. `en-US`, `tr-TR`) |

<!-- source: commands/flow.md -->

# `appitool flow`

Executes the automated 7-stage release orchestration pipeline (`setup` → `prebuild` → `build` → `postbuild` → `prerelease` → `release` → `postrelease`) with centralized error handling and webhook alerts.

## Synopsis

```bash
appitool flow ios [options]
appitool flow android [options]
```

See [Flow Architecture](https://appitool.appibara.com/guide/flow-architecture) for full stage-by-stage details and preset behaviors.

---

## `appitool flow ios`

Executes the automated release flow for iOS.

- When `-d appstore` (default) is used, runs **`IOSInternalPreset`** (App Store Connect / TestFlight upload).
- When `-d adhoc` is used, runs **`IOSAdHocPreset`** (ad-hoc signed IPA, Firebase App Distribution upload to `internal` tester group).
- When `-d development` is used, runs **`IOSDevelopmentPreset`** (development-signed IPA via Match `development` profiles and the `development` export method, Firebase App Distribution upload to `internal` tester group). Installs only on devices included in the development provisioning profile.

### Options

| Option / Flag | Default / `.env` Fallback | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `-d, --distribution <method>` | `appstore` | Distribution method: `adhoc`, `development`, or `appstore`. |
| `--dry-run` | `false` | Simulate pipeline execution without modifying Xcode projects, running builds, or uploading binaries. Forces Match `readonly` and skips notifications. |
| `-b, --bundle-id <id>` | `APPLE_BUNDLE_ID` | Target iOS bundle identifier. Auto-detected from Xcode project if omitted. |
| `-s, --scheme <scheme>` | `XCODE_SCHEME` | Xcode scheme to build. Auto-inferred if omitted. |
| `-c, --configuration <config>` | `XCODE_CONFIGURATION` | Build configuration (`Debug`, `Release`). |
| `--firebase-app-id <id>` | `FIREBASE_IOS_APP_ID` | Firebase App ID for iOS (used for Ad-Hoc / Firebase distribution). |
| `--silent` / `--no-silent` | `true` (`--silent`) | Suppress (`--silent`) or stream (`--no-silent`) `xcodebuild` and Match stdout logs. |
| `--wait-processing` / `--no-wait-processing` | `true` (`--wait-processing`) | Wait for App Store Connect build processing to apply TestFlight release notes (use `--no-wait-processing` to return immediately after upload even when release notes were generated). |

Plus shared option groups:
- [`AppleCredentialsOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#applecredentialsoptions) (`--apple-key-id`, `--apple-issuer-id`, `--apple-key`)
- [`GoogleCredentialsOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#googlecredentialsoptions) (`-g, --google-key`)
- [`MatchOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#matchoptions) (`--match-git-url`, `--match-git-branch`, `--match-git-token`, `--match-password`, `--keychain-name`, `--keychain-password`, `--team-id`, `--readonly`)
- [`NotificationOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#notificationoptions) (`--slack-url`, `--kokono-url`, `--kokono-public-key`)
- [`ReleaseNotesOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#releasenotesoptions) (`--release-notes`, `--notes-from`, `--notes-locale`)

### Examples

```bash
# Release to TestFlight / App Store Connect
appitool flow ios -d appstore -b com.example.app

# Distribute Ad-Hoc IPA via Firebase App Distribution with live build logs
appitool flow ios -d adhoc --no-silent

# Validate configuration and dry-run build increment
appitool flow ios -d appstore --dry-run
```

---

## `appitool flow android`

Executes the automated release flow for Android.

- When `-d appstore` (default) is used, runs **`AndroidInternalPreset`** (Google Play Console `internal` track).
- When `-d adhoc` is used, runs **`AndroidAdHocPreset`** (`release` build signed with the Match/release keystore, Firebase App Distribution upload to `internal` tester group).
- When `-d development` is used, runs **`AndroidDevelopmentPreset`** (`debug` build signed by the project's Gradle debug signing config — no Match keystore — Firebase App Distribution upload to `internal` tester group).

### Options

| Option / Flag | Default / `.env` Fallback | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `-d, --distribution <method>` | `appstore` | Distribution method: `adhoc`, `development`, or `appstore`. |
| `--dry-run` | `false` | Validate configuration, resolve Match keystore, inspect remote `versionCode`, and simulate upload without building or mutating state. |
| `--package-name <name>` | `GOOGLE_PACKAGE_NAME` | Target Android package name. Auto-detected from Gradle if omitted. |
| `--format <format>` | `aab` for `appstore`; `apk` for `adhoc`/`development` | Packaging format (`aab` or `apk`). `-d appstore` requires `aab` (Google Play rejects APKs); `--format apk` with `appstore` fails validation. |
| `--flavor <name>` | `ANDROID_FLAVOR` | Gradle product flavor (e.g., `production`, `staging`). Builds `bundle<Flavor>Release` / `assemble<Flavor>Release`, resolves flavor-specific `applicationId` (when `--package-name` is omitted), `versionName`, and `versionCode`, and names the artifact `<Target>_<flavor>_release`. |
| `--firebase-app-id <id>` | `FIREBASE_ANDROID_APP_ID` | Firebase App ID for Android (used for Ad-Hoc / Firebase distribution). |
| `--silent` / `--no-silent` | `true` (`--silent`) | Suppress (`--silent`) or show (`--no-silent`) Gradle and Match output. |

Plus shared option groups:
- [`GoogleCredentialsOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#googlecredentialsoptions) (`-g, --google-key`)
- [`MatchStorageOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#matchstorageoptions) (`--match-git-url`, `--match-git-branch`, `--match-git-token`, `--match-password`)
- [`NotificationOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#notificationoptions) (`--slack-url`, `--kokono-url`, `--kokono-public-key`)
- [`ReleaseNotesOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#releasenotesoptions) (`--release-notes`, `--notes-from`, `--notes-locale`)

### Examples

```bash
# Build AAB and upload to Google Play Console internal track
appitool flow android -d appstore --package-name com.example.app

# Build APK and distribute to Firebase App Distribution
appitool flow android -d adhoc --no-silent

# Build the production flavor AAB and upload to Google Play Console internal track
appitool flow android -d appstore --flavor production

# Dry-run Android Ad-Hoc flow
appitool flow android -d adhoc --dry-run
```

---

<!-- source: commands/build.md -->

# `appitool build`

Compiles and packages platform binaries directly without running the full 7-stage `flow` pipeline.

## Synopsis

```bash
appitool build ios [options]
appitool build android [options]
```

---

## `appitool build ios`

Builds and packages an iOS application using `xcodebuild` (comparable to Fastlane `build_app` / `gym`).

Artifacts are written under `~/.appitool/ios/<MainTarget>/build/<version>_<build>[_adhoc|_development]/` (falling back to `<yyyy_MM_dd_HH_mm>` when version or build number cannot be resolved) with DerivedData isolated in `~/.appitool/ios/<MainTarget>/derivedData/`.

### Options

| Option / Flag | Default / `.env` Fallback | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `-d, --distribution <method>` | `appstore` | Distribution method: `adhoc`, `development`, or `appstore`. Mapped to `app-store-connect`, `release-testing`, or `debugging` export methods. |
| `--workspace-path <path>` | `XCODE_WORKSPACE` or auto-detected | Path to `.xcworkspace`. |
| `--project <path>` | `XCODE_PROJECT` or auto-detected | Path to `.xcodeproj`. |
| `-s, --scheme <name>` | `XCODE_SCHEME` or inferred | Xcode scheme to build (inferred via `xcodebuild -list -json`). |
| `-c, --configuration <name>` | `XCODE_CONFIGURATION` or `Release` | Build configuration (`Debug`, `Release`). |
| `--team-id <id>` | `APPLE_TEAM_ID` | Apple Developer Team ID. |
| `--codesigning-identity <id>` | — | Code signing identity override (e.g., `"Apple Distribution"`, `"Apple Development"`). |
| `--clean` | `false` | Clean build folder before building. |
| `--skip-build-archive` | `false` | Skip compiling `.xcarchive` and export an IPA from the latest `.xcarchive` found under `~/.appitool/ios/<MainTarget>/build/`. |
| `--skip-package-ipa` | `false` | Only compile `.xcarchive` and skip IPA packaging. |
| `--allow-provisioning-updates` | `false` | Allow `xcodebuild` to communicate with Apple Developer Portal for provisioning updates (passes `-authenticationKeyPath`, `-authenticationKeyID`, `-authenticationKeyIssuerID` automatically if `APPLE_KEY` is a file path). |
| `--manage-build-number` | `false` | Allow App Store Connect to automatically manage/increment version and build numbers during export. |
| `--silent` / `--no-silent` | `true` (`--silent`) | Suppress (`--silent`) or stream (`--no-silent`) `xcodebuild` stdout logs. |
| `--xcodebuild-formatter <cmd>` | `XCODEBUILD_FORMATTER` or `xcbeautify --renderer github-actions` | Formatter command piped from `xcodebuild` output. |

Plus [`AppleCredentialsOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#applecredentialsoptions) (`--apple-key-id`, `--apple-issuer-id`, `--apple-key`).

### Examples

```bash
# Build App Store IPA (auto-discover workspace & scheme)
appitool build ios -d appstore

# Build Ad-Hoc IPA with automatic provisioning updates and clean build
appitool build ios -d adhoc --clean --allow-provisioning-updates

# Re-export IPA from the most recent existing .xcarchive
appitool build ios -d adhoc --skip-build-archive
```

---

## `appitool build android`

Builds an Android App Bundle (`.aab`) or APK (`.apk`) using Gradle (`./gradlew`).

Artifacts are written under `~/.appitool/android/<Target>/build/<version>_<build>[_adhoc|_development]/` (falling back to `<yyyy_MM_dd_HH_mm>` when version or build number cannot be resolved) named `<Target>_<flavor_><buildType>.<aab|apk>`.

### Signing Resolution Order

`build android` resolves signing credentials in the following order:
1. Base64 keystore via `--keystore-base64` / `ANDROID_KEYSTORE` (decoded temporarily into `~/.appitool/android/keystores/<packageName>.keystore` and removed automatically after build).
2. Local keystore file via `--keystore-path` / `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PATH`.
3. Match Git repository if `--match` is passed (or if `MATCH_GIT_URL` and `MATCH_PASSWORD` are set when no local keystore path was provided). If the Match lookup is attempted and fails — or `--match` is passed without Match storage configured — the build stops with an error instead of producing an unsigned artifact.

### Options

| Option / Flag | Default / `.env` Fallback | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `-d, --distribution <method>` | `appstore` | Distribution method: `adhoc`, `development`, or `appstore`. |
| `--package-name <name>` | `GOOGLE_PACKAGE_NAME` or Gradle-resolved | Target Android package name. |
| `--flavor <name>` | `ANDROID_FLAVOR` | Gradle product flavor (e.g., `production`, `staging`). |
| `-c, --configuration <type>` | `ANDROID_CONFIGURATION` or `Release` | Build configuration/type (`Release`, `Debug`). |
| `--format <format>` | `aab` for `appstore`; `apk` for `adhoc`/`development` | Packaging format (`aab` or `apk`). |
| `--clean` | `false` | Run Gradle `clean` before building. |
| `--silent` / `--no-silent` | `true` (`--silent`) | Suppress (`--silent`) or stream (`--no-silent`) Gradle stdout logs. |
| `--project-dir <path>` | `ANDROID_PROJECT_DIR`, `./android`, or `.` | Android root directory containing `gradlew`. |
| `--keystore-path <path>` | `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PATH` | Path to local keystore file. |
| `--keystore-base64 <str>` | `ANDROID_KEYSTORE` | Base64-encoded keystore content. |
| `--keystore-password <pass>` | `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD` | Keystore store password. |
| `--key-alias <alias>` | `ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS` | Key alias inside keystore. |
| `--key-password <pass>` | `ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD` | Key password. |
| `--gradle-opts <opts>` | — | Custom JVM options passed via `GRADLE_OPTS` (automatically appends `-Dorg.gradle.daemon=false` if omitted). |
| `--match` | `false` | Fetch signing keystore from Match Git repository. |

Plus [`MatchStorageOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#matchstorageoptions).

### Examples

```bash
# Build signed release AAB for Google Play using Match keystore
appitool build android -d appstore --match

# Build staging flavor APK cleanly with custom JVM heap
appitool build android -d adhoc --flavor staging --format apk --clean --gradle-opts "-Xmx4g"
```

---

<!-- source: commands/check.md -->

# `appitool check`

Verifies store credentials, API connectivity, application registration, and retrieves the latest remote build version and build number.

## Synopsis

```bash
appitool check ios [options]
appitool check android [options]
```

---

## `appitool check ios`

Checks iOS application metadata and latest build information from Firebase App Distribution (`adhoc`, default) or App Store Connect (`appstore`).

### Behavior by Distribution

- **`adhoc` (default)**: Requires `FIREBASE_IOS_APP_ID` (or `--firebase-app-id`) and `GOOGLE_KEY` (or `-g, --google-key`). Fetches Firebase iOS App info (`appId`, `bundleId`, `displayName`, `projectId`, `appStoreId`, `teamId`, `state`) and the latest Firebase release version/build number.
- **`appstore`**: Requires App Store Connect credentials (`APPLE_KEY`, `APPLE_KEY_ID`, `APPLE_ISSUER_ID`) and a bundle identifier (flag or auto-detected from Xcode project). Retrieves the latest TestFlight/App Store build version and build number.
- **`development`**: Prints a notice that development distribution has no remote store information.

### Options

| Option / Flag | Default / `.env` Fallback | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `-d, --distribution <method>` | `adhoc` | Distribution method: `adhoc`, `development`, or `appstore`. |
| `-b, --bundle-id <id>` | `APPLE_BUNDLE_ID` or auto-detected from Xcode project | Target iOS bundle identifier. |
| `--firebase-app-id <id>` | `FIREBASE_IOS_APP_ID` | Firebase App ID for iOS (used when `-d adhoc`). |

Plus [`AppleCredentialsOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#applecredentialsoptions) (`--apple-key-id`, `--apple-issuer-id`, `--apple-key`) and [`GoogleCredentialsOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#googlecredentialsoptions) (`-g, --google-key`).

### Examples

```bash
# Check latest Firebase App Distribution iOS app info & build
appitool check ios -d adhoc

# Check latest App Store Connect / TestFlight build for bundle ID
appitool check ios -d appstore -b com.example.app
```

---

## `appitool check android`

Checks Android application metadata and latest build information from Firebase App Distribution (`adhoc`, default) or Google Play Console (`appstore`).

### Behavior by Distribution

- **`adhoc` (default)**: Requires `FIREBASE_ANDROID_APP_ID` (or `--firebase-app-id`) and `GOOGLE_KEY` (or `-g, --google-key`). Displays Firebase Android App info (`appId`, `packageName`, `displayName`, `projectId`, `state`) and latest build info.
- **`appstore`**: Requires `GOOGLE_KEY` (or `-g, --google-key`) and a package name (flag or auto-detected from Android project). Queries Google Play Console for the latest version and build number (`versionCode`).
- **`development`**: Prints a notice that development distribution has no remote store information.

### Options

| Option / Flag | Default / `.env` Fallback | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `-d, --distribution <method>` | `adhoc` | Distribution method: `adhoc`, `development`, or `appstore`. |
| `--package-name <name>` | `GOOGLE_PACKAGE_NAME` or auto-detected from Android project | Target Android package name. |
| `--firebase-app-id <id>` | `FIREBASE_ANDROID_APP_ID` | Firebase App ID for Android (used when `-d adhoc`). |

Plus [`GoogleCredentialsOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#googlecredentialsoptions) (`-g, --google-key`).

### Examples

```bash
# Check Firebase App Distribution Android app info & latest release
appitool check android -d adhoc

# Check latest build versionCode on Google Play Console
appitool check android -d appstore --package-name com.example.app
```

<!-- source: commands/match.md -->

# `appitool match`

Synchronizes, prunes, nukes, or adds encrypted code signing certificates, provisioning profiles, and Android keystores stored in a Git repository. Fully compatible with Fastlane Match V1 (`AES-256-CBC`) and V2 (`AES-256-GCM`) encryption.

## Synopsis

```bash
appitool match ios [sync] [options]
appitool match ios nuke [options]
appitool match ios prune [options]
appitool match android [options]
```

> `ios` is the `defaultSubcommand` of `match`, and `sync` is the `defaultSubcommand` of `match ios`, so `appitool match -t adhoc` runs `appitool match ios sync -t adhoc`. Actions (`sync`, `nuke`, `prune`) are subcommands; distribution types are always passed with `-t, --type`.

---

## `appitool match ios`

Groups the Apple code signing actions. Each action is its own subcommand with its own options.

| Subcommand | Destructive | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `sync` *(default)* | No | Syncs certificates and profiles from Git storage, creating missing or expired ones when writable. |
| `nuke` | Yes | Revokes certificates and deletes provisioning profiles of one distribution type on Apple Developer Portal and in Git storage. |
| `prune` | Yes | Removes certificates and profiles that are revoked on Apple Developer Portal or expired from Git storage. |

### Shared Options (all `match ios` subcommands)

| Option / Flag | Default / `.env` Fallback | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `-p, --platform <platform>` | `ios` | Target Apple platform: `ios`, `macos`, `tvos`, `catalyst`. |
| `--silent` / `--no-silent` | `true` (`--silent`) | Suppress (`--silent`) or show (`--no-silent`) verbose logging. |

Plus [`AppleCredentialsOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#applecredentialsoptions) (`--apple-key-id`, `--apple-issuer-id`, `--apple-key`) and [`GlobalCIOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#globalcioptions) (`--ci` / `--no-ci`).

---

### `appitool match ios sync`

| Option / Flag | Default / `.env` Fallback | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `-t, --type <type>` | `MATCH_TYPE` or `appstore` | Distribution type: `appstore`, `development`, `adhoc`, `enterprise`, `developer_id`. |
| `--identifiers <ids>` | Auto-discovered from local Xcode project | Comma-separated bundle identifiers to sync profiles for. |
| `--force` | `false` | Force renewal of provisioning profiles even if still valid. |
| `--shallow-clone` / `--no-shallow-clone` | `true` for `--readonly`; `false` otherwise | Perform shallow Git clone (`--depth 1`). |
| `--team-name <name>` | — | Apple Developer Team Name (used as certificate CN when generating a new certificate). |

Plus [`MatchOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#matchoptions) (`--match-git-url`, `--match-git-branch`, `--match-git-token`, `--match-password`, `--keychain-name`, `--keychain-password`, `--team-id`, `--readonly`; `--readonly` defaults to `false` in `match ios sync`).

`sync` is not destructive, so it runs normally in CI mode.

---

### `appitool match ios nuke`

| Option / Flag | Default / `.env` Fallback | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `-t, --type <type>` | `MATCH_TYPE` or `appstore` | Distribution type to nuke: `appstore`, `development`, `adhoc`, `enterprise`, `developer_id`. |

Plus [`MatchStorageOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#matchstorageoptions) (`--match-git-url`, `--match-git-branch`, `--match-git-token`, `--match-password`).

Requires App Store Connect API credentials. Skipped as a no-op (exit code `0`) in CI mode unless `--no-ci` is passed.

---

### `appitool match ios prune`

| Option / Flag | Default / `.env` Fallback | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `-t, --type <type>` | `MATCH_TYPE` or `appstore` | Distribution type to prune: `appstore`, `development`, `adhoc`, `enterprise`, `developer_id`. |
| `--all` | `false` | Prune across all distribution types (cannot be combined with `-t, --type`). |

Plus [`MatchStorageOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#matchstorageoptions) (`--match-git-url`, `--match-git-branch`, `--match-git-token`, `--match-password`).

Requires App Store Connect API credentials. Skipped as a no-op (exit code `0`) in CI mode unless `--no-ci` is passed.

---

### Examples

```bash
# Sync App Store certificates and profiles (creates missing if writable)
appitool match ios -t appstore

# Read-only CI sync for Ad-Hoc profiles across specific bundle IDs
appitool match ios sync -t adhoc --readonly --identifiers "com.example.app,com.example.app.widget"

# Prune revoked/expired assets across all profile types from Git storage
appitool match ios prune --all

# Nuke development certificates and profiles on portal and Git repo
appitool match ios nuke -t development
```

---

## `appitool match android`

Syncs an encrypted Android keystore (`.keystore`, `.jks`, `.p12`) from Git storage or encrypts and adds a local keystore + metadata JSON into Git storage.

### Modes

- **Sync Mode (default)**: Clones and decrypts `android/<configuration>/<packageName>.<keystore|jks|p12>` and `<packageName>.json`, copying the keystore into `~/.appitool/android/keystores/<packageName>.keystore`.
- **Add Mode (`-k, --keystore`)**: Encrypts the local keystore (and optional credential metadata JSON when `--alias`, `--keystore-password`, and `--key-password` are provided) using Match V2 (`AES-256-GCM`) and pushes it to the Git repository.

### Options & Flags

| Option / Flag | Default / `.env` Fallback | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `--package-name <name>` | `GOOGLE_PACKAGE_NAME` or Gradle-resolved | Target Android application package name. |
| `-c, --configuration <type>` | `release` | Build type (`release` or `debug`). |
| `-k, --keystore <path>` | — | Path to local keystore file to encrypt and add to Match Git storage (omit to sync). |
| `--alias <name>` | `ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS` | Key alias inside keystore. |
| `--keystore-password <pass>` | `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD` | Keystore password. |
| `--key-password <pass>` | `ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD` | Key password. |
| `--silent` / `--no-silent` | `true` (`--silent`) | Suppress (`--silent`) or show (`--no-silent`) verbose output. |

Plus [`MatchStorageOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#matchstorageoptions) (`--match-git-url`, `--match-git-branch`, `--match-git-token`, `--match-password`).

### Examples

```bash
# Add and encrypt a local release keystore with credentials metadata
appitool match android \
  --package-name com.example.app \
  -k ./android/app/release.keystore \
  --alias upload \
  --keystore-password "store_secret" \
  --key-password "key_secret"

# Sync release keystore from Match Git repository
appitool match android --package-name com.example.app -c release
```

---

<!-- source: commands/apple.md -->

# `appitool apple`

Direct management of Apple App Store Connect and Apple Developer Portal resources via the App Store Connect OpenAPI client.

All `apple` subcommands accept [`AppleCredentialsOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#applecredentialsoptions) (`--apple-key-id`, `--apple-issuer-id`, `--apple-key`), falling back to `APPLE_KEY_ID`, `APPLE_ISSUER_ID`, and `APPLE_KEY` in `.env` / environment variables.

> [!NOTE]
> **CI Guard:** Destructive subcommands (`identifiers delete`, `profiles delete`, `profiles prune`, `certificates delete`, `certificates prune`, `devices disable`, `users delete`, `invitations cancel`, `versions delete`, and `assets delete`) accept [`GlobalCIOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#globalcioptions) (`--ci` / `--no-ci`) and are skipped as a no-op (exit code `0`) when running in CI mode. Pass `--no-ci` to force execution in CI.

## Synopsis

```bash
appitool apple <resource> <action> [options]
```

## Subcommands Summary

| Category | Subcommands |
|:---|:---|
| **Apps** | `apps list` |
| **Versions** | `versions create`, `versions delete` |
| **App / Bundle Identifiers** | `identifiers list`, `identifiers create`, `identifiers delete`, `capabilities list` |
| **Provisioning Profiles** | `profiles list`, `profiles create`, `profiles delete`, `profiles prune` |
| **Certificates** | `certificates list`, `certificates create`, `certificates delete`, `certificates prune` |
| **Devices** | `devices list`, `devices create`, `devices disable` |
| **Users** | `users list`, `users invite`, `users update`, `users delete` |
| **Invitations** | `invitations list`, `invitations cancel` |
| **Assets** (screenshots, product page header, search results) | `assets list`, `assets upload`, `assets download`, `assets delete`, `assets types`, `assets specs` |
| **Metadata** (name, subtitle, description, keywords, promotional text, what's new, URLs) | `metadata list`, `metadata download`, `metadata upload` |

---

## Apps

### `appitool apple apps list`

Lists applications registered in App Store Connect (name, bundle ID, App ID, SKU, primary locale).

| Option | Description |
|:---|:---|
| `-b, --bundle-id <id>` | Filter by bundle identifier (e.g. `com.example.app`). |
| `-n, --name <name>` | Filter by application name. |
| `-l, --limit <count>` | Maximum number of items to return (omit to fetch all). |

```bash
appitool apple apps list
appitool apple apps list -b com.example.app
```

### `appitool apple versions create`

Creates a new App Store version (`POST /v1/appStoreVersions`). App Store Connect copies the previous version's texts and screenshots into it, and an editable app info becomes available, so [`apple metadata`](#metadata-appitool-apple-metadata) and [`apple assets`](#assets-appitool-apple-assets) can edit it right away.

**Version string:**

- **`--app-version` given:** that version is created as-is. App Store Connect validates it; if it rejects the request, the command exits with Apple's error message plus a likely cause (e.g. HTTP 409: another version is still editable or the version already exists; 400/422: invalid or not higher than the latest version; 401/403: API key role). The Xcode project is not changed.
- **`--app-version` omitted:**
  1. If a version is already editable for the platform (App Store Connect allows only one), the command stops and names it — nothing is changed.
  2. The Xcode project's `MARKETING_VERSION` is used when it is higher than every existing App Store version (or when the app has no versions yet).
  3. Otherwise (project version lower or equal, or no project found), the latest App Store version's patch number is bumped (`1.0.8` → `1.0.9`). When a project was found, its `MARKETING_VERSION` is set to the new version **after** App Store Connect accepted it (all distributable targets; literal `CFBundleShortVersionString` values in `Info.plist` are pointed at `$(MARKETING_VERSION)`; `.xcconfig` files are not changed).

| Option / Flag | Default | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `--app-version <x.y.z>` | Xcode project / bumped latest (see above) | Version string to create. |
| `-b, --bundle-id <id>` / `--app-id <id>` | `APPLE_BUNDLE_ID` / Xcode project | Target app. |
| `-p, --platform <platform>` | `ios` | `ios`, `macos`, `tvos`, `visionos`. |
| `--release-type <type>` | App Store Connect default | `manual`, `after-approval`, or `scheduled`. |
| `--release-date <iso8601>` | — | Earliest release date; required for and only allowed with `--release-type scheduled`. |
| `--copyright <text>` | — | Copyright text. |
| `--project <path>` / `--workspace-path <path>` | `XCODE_PROJECT` / `XCODE_WORKSPACE` / auto-detected | Xcode project used for the default version and the `MARKETING_VERSION` update. |
| `--dry-run` | `false` | Show the version that would be created (and whether the project would be updated) without changing anything. |

```bash
# Use the Xcode project version, or bump the latest App Store version
appitool apple versions create --dry-run
appitool apple versions create

# Create an explicit version that is released automatically after approval
appitool apple versions create --app-version 2.0.0 --release-type after-approval
```

### `appitool apple versions delete`

Deletes an App Store version that is still being prepared (`DELETE /v1/appStoreVersions/{id}`), including its localized texts, screenshots, and App Review details. Asset Library images stay in the library, and a `MARKETING_VERSION` bumped by `versions create` is not reverted. Destructive: skipped in CI mode unless `--no-ci` is passed.

- Without `--app-version`, the platform's editable version is deleted; if there is none, nothing happens.
- With `--app-version`, that version must exist and be editable; live, in-review, or released versions are refused before calling App Store Connect.
- App Store Connect makes the final decision (it generally only removes versions that were never submitted for review); its error is shown with a likely cause.

| Option / Flag | Default | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `--app-version <x.y.z>` | Current editable version | Version to delete. |
| `-b, --bundle-id <id>` / `--app-id <id>` | `APPLE_BUNDLE_ID` / Xcode project | Target app. |
| `-p, --platform <platform>` | `ios` | `ios`, `macos`, `tvos`, `visionos`. |
| `--dry-run` | `false` | Show which version would be deleted. |
| `--ci` / `--no-ci` | auto | CI guard (see [`GlobalCIOptions`](https://appitool.appibara.com/commands/overview#globalcioptions)). |

```bash
appitool apple versions delete --dry-run
appitool apple versions delete --app-version 1.0.9
```

---

## Bundle Identifiers & Capabilities

### `appitool apple identifiers list`

Lists App/Bundle Identifiers registered on Apple Developer Portal.

| Option | Description |
|:---|:---|
| `-b, --bundle-id <id>` | Filter by bundle identifier. |
| `-l, --limit <count>` | Maximum number of items to return. |

```bash
appitool apple identifiers list
```

### `appitool apple identifiers create`

Registers a new App/Bundle Identifier with optional capabilities on Apple Developer Portal.

| Option | Default | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `-b, --bundle-id <id>` | — | App/Bundle identifier (e.g. `com.example.app`). |
| `-n, --name <name>` | Bundle ID | Description or name of the App Identifier. |
| `-p, --platform <platform>` | `universal` | Platform: `universal`, `ios`, or `macos`. |
| `--capabilities <list>` | — | Comma-separated capability keys (e.g. `push-notifications,in-app-purchase`). |

```bash
appitool apple identifiers create \
  -b com.example.app \
  -n "Example App" \
  --capabilities "push-notifications,sign-in-with-apple,associated-domains"
```

### `appitool apple identifiers delete`

Deletes an App/Bundle Identifier from Apple Developer Portal. Any provisioning profiles tied to the identifier are invalidated by Apple. Bundle IDs actively linked to an App Store Connect App record cannot be deleted.

| Option | Description |
|:---|:---|
| `-b, --bundle-id <id>` | App/Bundle identifier to delete (required). |

```bash
appitool apple identifiers delete -b com.example.app
```

### `appitool apple capabilities list`

- When called **without `-b`**: Lists all 28 supported capability keys and their App Store Connect enum names (no credentials required).
- When called **with `-b, --bundle-id <id>`**: Queries Apple Developer Portal and lists capabilities enabled for that Bundle ID.

```bash
# List all supported capability keys
appitool apple capabilities list

# Inspect capabilities enabled for an existing App ID
appitool apple capabilities list -b com.example.app
```

#### Supported Capability Keys

| Category | CLI Key (Aliases) | API Enum | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **Push & Communication** | `push-notifications` (`push`) | `PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS` | APNs remote push notifications |
| | `inter-app-audio` | `INTER_APP_AUDIO` | Real-time audio streaming with host apps |
| | `coremedia-hls-low-latency` | `COREMEDIA_HLS_LOW_LATENCY` | Low-Latency HTTP Live Streaming (HLS) |
| **Authentication & Security** | `sign-in-with-apple` (`apple-sign-in`, `apple-id-auth`) | `APPLE_ID_AUTH` | Sign in with Apple authentication |
| | `data-protection` | `DATA_PROTECTION` | Hardware-based file-level encryption |
| | `autofill-credential-provider` | `AUTOFILL_CREDENTIAL_PROVIDER` | AutoFill password manager extensions |
| **App Integration & Domains** | `associated-domains` | `ASSOCIATED_DOMAINS` | Universal Links, App Clips, Web Credentials |
| | `app-groups` | `APP_GROUPS` | Shared container access for App Extensions & Widgets |
| | `icloud` | `ICLOUD` | CloudKit database and iCloud document storage |
| | `game-center` | `GAME_CENTER` | Game Center leaderboards, achievements & multiplayer |
| | `in-app-purchase` (`iap`) | `IN_APP_PURCHASE` | In-App Purchases & StoreKit |
| **Payments & Wallet** | `apple-pay` | `APPLE_PAY` | Apple Pay in-app payment processing |
| | `wallet` (`passbook`) | `WALLET` | Passes, tickets, and boarding passes in Apple Wallet |
| **Hardware & Networking** | `nfc-tag-reading` (`nfc`) | `NFC_TAG_READING` | Near Field Communication (NFC) tag reading |
| | `access-wifi-information` (`wifi-info`) | `ACCESS_WIFI_INFORMATION` | Access current Wi-Fi network SSID/BSSID |
| | `hot-spot` | `HOT_SPOT` | Wi-Fi HotSpot network configuration |
| | `personal-vpn` | `PERSONAL_VPN` | Personal VPN tunnels and connections |
| | `network-extensions` | `NETWORK_EXTENSIONS` | Custom network tunnels, DNS proxies, content filters |
| | `network-custom-protocol` | `NETWORK_CUSTOM_PROTOCOL` | Custom network protocol extensions |
| | `multipath` | `MULTIPATH` | Multipath TCP for concurrent Wi-Fi and Cellular data |
| | `wireless-accessory-configuration` | `WIRELESS_ACCESSORY_CONFIGURATION` | MFi accessory Wi-Fi configuration |
| **Health & Home** | `healthkit` | `HEALTHKIT` | HealthKit health and fitness records |
| | `homekit` | `HOMEKIT` | HomeKit smart home automation & accessories |
| **Siri & Maps & System** | `sirikit` | `SIRIKIT` | SiriKit voice shortcuts and intents |
| | `maps` | `MAPS` | MapKit turn-by-turn routing and directions |
| | `classkit` | `CLASSKIT` | ClassKit student progress & educational activities |
| | `system-extension-install` | `SYSTEM_EXTENSION_INSTALL` | macOS system extensions & driver extensions |
| | `user-management` | `USER_MANAGEMENT` | Multi-user management on Shared iPad |
